reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend with a holidays parameter and adds one isNonWorkingDay predicate that every weekend site (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule templates) now uses.

duplication.why: The holiday rule itself is defined once, but the three pre-existing daily-skip sites each repeat `config.holidays ?? []` and their own look-ahead padding (`+ holidays.length`) adjustment.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend helper; the type change is on RecurConfig and parseRecurDate carries the field through like weekendSolve.

scope.why: Only the holidays plumbing, the shared helpers, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: A clear isNonWorkingDay plus a loop-based mover is easy to own; the scattered holidays defaults and per-site occurrence-window padding are the weak spot.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No site keeps a bare d.isWeekend check or its own move logic; all go through isNonWorkingDay/getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: The previous weekend checks are replaced by calls to the new predicate, not reshaped copies.

one_place.where: isNonWorkingDay and getDateWithSkippedWeekend in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts decide what counts as a non-working day and how to move off it for every schedule date path.
